messages:
sara_ops: Seeing elevated 502s from na-west backend health checks since 07:12 UTC. grafana shows rapid connection resets on GPU fleet nodes :confused:

matt_infra: on it. I can see the healthcheck fail rate spike at 07:11. Likely a networking path problem between GCLB and the na-west edge pool.

vikas_sre: Confirmed. BPF conntrack counters on na-west edges are spiking, drops to established TCP.

zoe_prod: Customers on na-west are reporting latency + some request failures. Should we shift traffic out?

matt_infra: Propose temporary weight override on the global router: divert 60% from na-west to eu-central, 30% to ap-southeast, keep 10% for local affinity. This avoids full evacuation.

sara_ops: Agree with gradual shift. Can we do header-steer for critical enterprise customers to keep them on dedicated pools?

matt_infra: Yes — will add a header-based exception for routes with x-customer-tier:enterprise so they stay pinned.

vikas_sre: Preparing script to update weights and set the header rule. Running in dry-run first. Script snippet:```bash
# update weights
curl -X POST https://router-api.internal/v1/weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"na-west":0.1,"eu-central":0.6,"ap-southeast":0.3}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started by matt_infra - change-set id cs-2105-weights-override

matt_infra: Deployed weights in two steps: step1 30% -> eu/10% -> ap, step2 remaining. Monitoring now.

oncall-bot: alert suppressed for na-west health checks for 30m while override active.

zoe_prod: Noting cost impact: routing more to eu-central increases cross-region egress and higher GPU spot pricing, estimate +12% hourly cost if sustained. Filing a cost watch.

vikas_sre: Telemetry: 502s dropping, p99 latency improving in 60s. conntrack drops falling. Looks like routing change relieved the path.

sara_ops: Leaving 10% on na-west to keep stateful affinity warm. Will we run a full pool restart or wait for network team?

matt_infra: Waiting on network team for BPF rule rollback. If they don't have a fix in 20m we'll escalate to full pool restart for affected nodes.

network-team (note): investigating kernel bump on na-west that rolled a new conntrack patch. root cause flagged, working on a config tweak.

matt_infra: Can we add a temporary autoscaler tweak to avoid scaling into the bad AZ? Set max surge to 0 for na-west GPU pool.

vikas_sre: Done. autoscaler override applied.

zoe_prod: I'll open a customer-facing status note for impacted accounts and include mitigation plan + cost note.

deploy-bot: change-set cs-2105-weights-override applied successfully.

matt_infra: Follow-ups: 1) network team rollback, 2) re-evaluate weights after 15m, 3) run canary restart if needed.

sara_ops: Thanks all. Update here when network patch lands or if we need to escalate to full evacuation. :thumbsup:
